name: from-paper
description: Paper to code: extract an artboard or section into components with exact CSS from get_computed_styles, mapped to project tokens.

steps.name: Session init (once per session)
steps.instruction: Load the Paper guide, file info and tokens. Resolve {prefix}, {token_files}, {framework}, {font} and {class_prefix} per project-conventions.md and report each with its source. Paper disconnected: stop with setup steps.

steps.name: Section inventory
steps.instruction: Screenshot the section, get the full tree summary, catalog every node.

steps.name: Deep extraction
steps.instruction: Batch get_computed_styles on every node, get_jsx for structure, record text. Finish before writing code.
checklist: Computed styles for every node, leaves included

steps.name: Token mapping
steps.instruction: Map every Paper var(--token) to a {prefix}* token; add missing tokens to {token_files}.
checklist: Every value mapped or added as a token

steps.name: Build component
steps.instruction: Write the {framework} component from the extracted structure and mapped tokens.

steps.name: Build CSS
steps.instruction: Write classes from extracted values, token references only.

steps.name: Add interactions
steps.instruction: Wire hover, click and keyboard behavior from {spec}; motion from the Paper frame strip, else {spec}.

steps.name: Verify
steps.instruction: Load in the browser and compare with the Paper screenshot; spot-check properties. Start dev servers only in a worktree.

tone: Surgical. A transfer, not a design operation. The artboard is the spec; nothing is invented.
